Game Overview

Gravity Grid is a puzzle title where dive into Gravity Grid, where dazzling metallic blocks descend, challenging your strategic prowess. Align and rotate them to clear rows amidst radiant gold backdrops. With accelerating speeds, each move tests your precision and agility. Can you master the falling frenzy and keep your grid under control?
